Hi Lynn — quick technical clarifications from the platform side:

1) EU Data Transfers: Redwood relies on controller-to-processor SCCs for Hosted customers and offers options for regional data residency in our EU region. For Dedicated/Private we support customer-controlled keys (bring-your-own-key) and can localize inference workloads to avoid cross-border egress.

2) Encryption & KMS: We use AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. For customers asking for HSM-backed key management we integrate with external KMS providers (AWS KMS / GCP KMS / Azure Key Vault) and can provide attestation artifacts on request.

3) HIPAA/BAA: technical feasibility notes attached — short answer: possible with Private/Dedicated deployments plus contractual BAA; Hosted requires a product-level evaluation and limited feature gating (we block certain telemetry exports and require data retention agreements). We estimate a 10-15 business day engineering runway to put the remaining controls in place for large-scale PHI ingestion (audit logging retention changes, additional access controls).

If MedCare needs a formal SOC2 NDA to receive the full SOC2 report, share the signed NDA and I'll route the report. Happy to jump on a 30-min call to walk through the SIG evidence map.

-Rafael
Director, Product Security, Redwood Inference
